instruction: A candid, clean studio photograph in a medium shot showing two women laughing during a hand-clapping game against a plain beige backdrop. On the left, the woman with short brown hair (R2) in a striped shirt and beige pants sits facing right, laughing heartily. On the right, the woman with dark curly afro hair (R1) in a purple long-sleeve shirt sits facing left, smiling and laughing. They look at each other as the woman with short brown hair's left hand touches the woman with dark curly afro hair's right hand, capturing a moment of playful motion. The scene is illuminated by soft, even studio lighting with a warm, neutral palette.
